subject: CareLoop demo request and qualification
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@careloop.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CareLoop demo request

Hi Rishi / Redwood team,

We signed up today and are evaluating Redwood for a clinical triage assistant we're building at CareLoop. Quick context:

- Use case: clinical triage + patient messaging automation (appointment reminders, symptom checks)
- Estimated volume: ~50k messages/month, with peaks around 3k messages/hour during daytime hours
- Timeline: hoping to run a pilot in August and go to production in Q4 if things look good

Could we schedule a short 30-min demo to see the platform, discuss performance, and talk about deployment options (hosted vs private)? Also have a few pre-demo questions: SOC 2 status, data retention controls, model privacy, and pricing for high-volume customers.

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Head of Product | CareLoop
samir.k@careloop.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@careloop.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareLoop demo request
Attachments: redwood-enterprise-one-pager.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Samir — welcome and thanks for signing up. Happy to run a 30-min demo and tailor it to the triage use case. A couple of quick qualification questions so Marissa (AE) and I can prep the right demo:

1) Data flow: will PHI flow into Redwood? If so, do you expect structured records or free-text clinical notes?
2) Volume profile: is the 50k/mo primarily automated outbound messages or user-initiated chats?
3) Timeline & decision criteria: who's the decision owner and what are your go/no-go criteria for the August pilot?

Proposed next steps:
- Pick a 30-min slot here: https://calendly.com/rishi/redwood-demo (I blocked a few windows next week)
- If you prefer, suggest 2-3 times and I'll coordinate

Looping in Marissa to join the call — she'll cover pricing/contract and eng integration details. I attached a short one-pager with our deployment options.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
SDR, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@careloop.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-25T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareLoop demo request

Thanks Rishi — answers below inline.

1) PHI: yes, some messages will include PHI (patient-first name, appointment times, brief symptom descriptors). We need to understand data residency and encryption.
2) Volume profile: ~70% automated outbound (reminders & triage pushes), ~30% user-initiated chats. Peak hours are 9am-2pm PT.
3) Timeline & decision owner: I'm leading the pilot decision and our CTO (ajay@careloop.ai) will sign off on infra questions. Key criteria: latency under 300ms for short replies, SOC 2 or equivalent, and reasonable unit economics for 50k+/mo.

Available for a demo next week: Tue 6/30 between 10-12 PT or Wed 7/1 after 1pm PT. If those don't work, I can propose alternatives.

—Samir
